_comment: Mock XAPI database for tests: one pool with two hosts (the second in maintenance mode), their control domains, guest VMs in different power states, a default and a user template, a snapshot, local, shared NFS and ISO storage (the ISO SR is broken: unplugged on the second host), the guest tools SR, networks with a VLAN and the hidden host-internal network, NICs and metrics. Records are partial; the client ignores missing fields; SM plugins for the storage types; PBD device_config pointing at the mock storage (nfs.lab).
